description: A neighborhood network where members share tools, skills, spaces, and services to reduce costs and build everyday resilience.
Peer-led workshops, mentoring, and career support that help members develop practical skills and access new opportunities.
A transparent community fund supporting small enterprises, emergency needs, and locally identified opportunities.
A shared library of tools and equipment that members can borrow for home repairs, gardening, events, and community projects.
Shared growing spaces that improve access to fresh food, strengthen local food systems, and bring neighbors together.
A reciprocal care network where members provide and receive practical support, companionship, and wellbeing check-ins.
A program that equips young people with leadership, civic engagement, and project-design skills through community-led initiatives.
A cooperative network connecting local businesses to shared resources, joint purchasing, mentoring, and community visibility.
Device access, connectivity support, and digital skills training that help community members participate fully online.
A rapid-response fund providing practical and financial support to community members during unexpected hardship or crisis.
A member-led cooperative offering affordable repairs, maintenance skills, and safe-housing improvements for participating households.
Activities that connect older and younger community members for mutual learning, companionship, and practical support.
A supportive network helping women entrepreneurs access training, capital, mentorship, and collaborative business opportunities.
Community-led projects that reduce local environmental impact through energy savings, waste reduction, greening, and climate education.
Plain-language legal information, referrals, and navigation support that help residents understand and access their rights.
